Vendored for the clean-slate native UI (engine/native): RmlUi's default font
engine needs FreeType. Built as the static library `native_freetype` by a
hand-authored target in engine/native/CMakeLists.txt (NOT via FreeType's own
CMake — see VENDOR.md).

All external dependencies are OFF (equivalent to FreeType's
FT_DISABLE_ZLIB / FT_DISABLE_BZIP2 / FT_DISABLE_PNG / FT_DISABLE_HARFBUZZ /
FT_DISABLE_BROTLI). The shipped include/freetype/config/ftoption.h leaves
FT_CONFIG_OPTION_SYSTEM_ZLIB / USE_BZIP2 / USE_PNG / USE_HARFBUZZ / USE_BROTLI
commented out, so the vendored source has zero transitive dependencies. gzip
(.gz) support uses FreeType's *bundled* zlib in src/gzip/ (FT_CONFIG_OPTION_USE_ZLIB
on, SYSTEM_ZLIB off) — self-contained, no external zlib.

Do not edit files in this tree. Hashes: MANIFEST.sha256 (enforced by
engine/cmake/FtdSourceLint.cmake).

Upgrade:
  git clone --depth 1 --branch VER-<X-Y-Z> https://github.com/freetype/freetype.git
  Copy include/, src/ (minus src/tools/), builds/, CMakeLists.txt, modules.cfg,
  LICENSE.TXT, docs/FTL.TXT, docs/GPLv2.TXT. Normalise EOLs to LF.
  Rebuild MANIFEST.sha256.
